videos.headline: Bueckers' 31-point night propels UConn to the Final Four
videos.description: Paige Bueckers tallies 31 points, 6 assists and 4 steals as the UConn Huskies advance to their 24th Final Four.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCW Highlight (Bueckers' 31-point night propels UConn to the Final Four) 2025/04/01 ESHEET SOTFULL
